decisions.reason: As a newly launched multi-item range with its own page and clear fit with the firm's stated portfolio expansion in consumer health, management would be strongly inclined to continue it.
This supplement received visible standalone promotion at launch and supports the firm's broaden-the-portfolio strategy, so recent investment and public commitment favor persistence.
Although less prominently presented than A or B, it still extends the established supplement offer and disappointing early uptake could readily be treated as temporary.

This niche immune supplement appears to have lower visibility and may be more uncertain commercially, but its very recent launch and fit with the consumer-health expansion still make withdrawal unlikely within a year.

Despite the 2018 Valsartan problem notice, management can attribute setbacks to a temporary external quality issue rather than the product concept itself, and sunk regulatory and launch costs support staying in the market.
